notes: Standard tier, global routing, list prices read 2026-11-11 (long-context tiers read 2026-11-12). Claude cache_write is the 1-hour cache-write rate (Claude Code writes 1-hour cache entries; the rate reproduces the CLI's total_cost_usd). long_context is the tier above above_input_tokens prompt tokens per request: Claude Haiku 5.5 above 100,000 tokens (5x its ordinary rates); the OpenAI models above 272K input tokens (input and cache rates 2x, output 1.5x). OpenAI cache_write is the 30-minute rate; gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.4 are absent because their page lists no cache-write rate. gpt-5.6-sol carries promotional pricing that the vendor page says is available until 2026-11-30. Model aliases (haiku, opus) are never priced: Claude reports canonical model names.
